page.layout: One column of running text, left of centre, with no marginal notes. Faint marks at the top right and a watermark at the bottom right are not printed text.

main_text.p: occidas, sed etiam ne temet ipsum; adeoque mandat, ut temet defendas, ac tue[?]ris. Ut arceas & evites omne incom-modum, quodque naturæ est adversum aut deleterium. Ve-rum, qui se potius occidi pati-tur, quam ut avertat plagas sibi illatas, etiam cum damno, cum internecione adversarii, non sibi consulit, quantum potest, nec conservationi sui intentus est, verum efficit, ut illa lex, non occides, in propriâ persona vio-

page.notes: The word after "defendas, ac" is hard to read: it may be "tueaeris" or "tueáris"; marked [?]. The line-end hyphens are as printed. The lower part of the page is cut off, so the text ends mid-word at "vio-".
